vr.look: A diorama is a small, real-looking scene. An alcove is a small open room off a big space. Put one model in four alcoves and the globe in the middle.

groups.title: One model for each part of the region

models.name: Corn Stage 4
models.why: Mexico: tortillas are made from corn

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Explorations in Filter environments. Click OptimaED Explorations Hub, then Begin Solo. It has big grassy alcoves around the middle.

steps.title: Build the four corners
steps.html: Put the globe in the middle. Then put one model in each of four alcoves: lumber for Canada, Statue of Liberty for the United States, corn for Mexico, sailboat for the Caribbean.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until your whole diorama fits. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Make each model the same size. No corner is more important.

vr.full: One photo that shows all four corners and the globe in the middle.

studio.title: Picture Match
studio.look: Six museum pictures. Each one shows something from Canada, the United States, Mexico or the Caribbean. The lines on the right tell what each picture shows.
studio.do: Tap a picture. Then tap the line that goes with it. You can also drag the picture onto the line.

game.miss: Not that line. Look at the picture again: what place could it be?
game.done: All six match! Each place is different, and all four share one continent.

left.alt: Kids playing hockey on a frozen pond near pine trees

pairs.ok: Yes! This steel drum band played on Antigua, an island in the Caribbean.
